# @ndigo/view-webcomponent

Web Component view technology for Ndigo — component creation and event binding

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `AbstractWebComponent` — Base class for Ndigo custom elements.
- `NdigoElement` *(type)* — Contract for a custom element that exposes a name: the element's tag name reflected as a `name` property by the `AsNdigoElement` mixin.
- `AsNdigoElement` — Adds a `name` property that reflects the element's `name` attribute.
- `RenderHost` *(type)* — A DOM node that can host a rendered subtree: an element, a shadow root, an iframe document, or a fragment.
- `DOMViewTarget` *(type)* — View target contract for DOM-backed render destinations.
- `likeDOMViewTarget` — Detects whether a value implements the DOM-specific view target contract.
- `DOMElementViewTarget` — View target implementation that renders into a host DOM node.
- `ShadowRootViewTarget` — A view target that renders into a shadow root.
- `IframeViewTarget` — A view target that renders into the document of a same-origin `<iframe>`.
- `FormAssociatedElement` *(type)* — The form-participation surface produced by AsFormAssociated.
- `AsFormAssociated` — Marks a custom element as form-associated (FACE) and bridges its value into native form submission through `ElementInternals`.
- `TagMapping` — Registers a custom element name and stores it in decorator metadata.
- `ModelAwareElement` *(type)* — An HTMLElement that carries the view model used to render it.
- `WebComponentView` — A view that renders a custom element into a view target.
- `ViewMapping` — Registers a view name in decorator metadata for later lookup.
- `WebComponentViewResolverOptions` *(type)* — Configuration for WebComponentViewResolver.
- `WebComponentViewResolver` — Resolves view names to `WebComponentView` descriptors.
- `ViewTargetSelector` *(type)* — Resolves a CSS selector for one render pass.
- `ViewTargetMount` *(type)* — Where a selected element receives rendered content.
- `SelectorViewTargeterOptions` *(type)* — Options for SelectorViewTargeter.
- `SelectorViewTargeter` — Resolves a selector to a cached DOM view target.
- `idSelector` — Builds a selector for an element id.
- `destroyViewTargeters` — Destroys every targeter in `targeters` that owns cached targets.
- `NameSelectorResolver` *(type)* — Maps a view name to a selector.
- `NameViewTargeter` — Targets the element named after the rendered view.
- `RouteSelectorMap` *(type)* — Maps a route pattern to a selector.
- `RouteViewTargeterOptions` *(type)* — Options for RouteViewTargeter.
- `RouteViewTargeter` — ': '#sidebar', '/': '#app' }); ```
- `AttributeViewTargeterOptions` *(type)* — Options for AttributeViewTargeter.
- `AttributeViewTargeter` — Targets the element named by a route attribute.
- `hydrateIslands` — Hydrates all islands in a root element: finds every `[data-ndigo-island]` marker, connects it to its serialized `data-ndigo-model`, and drives the element's fi…
- `WebMCPToolAnnotations` *(type)* — Safety hints understood by WebMCP hosts — the neutral AgentToolAnnotations vocabulary.
- `WebMCPTool` *(type)* — WebMCPTool.
- `WebMCPRegistration` *(type)* — Registration outcome — the neutral AgentToolRegistration handle. `supported` is false when the browser lacks WebMCP.
- `WebMCPOptions` *(type)* — WebMCPOptions.
- `declareWebMcpTool` — Registers one WebMCP tool. Unsupported browsers return a no-op registration.
- `provideWebMcpTools` — Registers a set of WebMCP tools under one AbortController.
- `webMcpAgentHost` — The WebMCP adapter over the neutral AgentToolHost contract — the first host adapter. Code that registers tools through this binding is host-agnostic: the plann…
- `WebMCPHandlerToolOptions` *(type)* — WebMCPHandlerToolOptions.
- `webMcpToolForHandler` — Projects a handler method and its `@parameters`/`validatedBy` metadata into a WebMCP tool. Arguments are validated with the same extractor converters the HTTP…
- `WebMCPElementBase` *(type)* — The element base contract the WebMCP mixin requires: a host element with the optional custom-element lifecycle callbacks the mixin chains into.
- `AsWebMCPElement` — Mixin that registers an element's WebMCP tools on connect and aborts them on disconnect. Subclasses implement WebMCPElement.webMcpTools; they can read dependen…
- `WebMCPElement` *(type)* — WebMCPElement.
